endpoints.description:
Severe asthma exacerbation rate over the 52-Week treatment period in a pre-specified pooled analysis of 2 pivotal studies CCD-05993AB1-03 (TRIMARAN) and CCD-05993AB2-02 (TRIGGER).

The pooled analysis of pivotal studies TRIMARAN and TRIGGER was a pre-specified secondary outcome measure for this study. Both studies have identical design, duration, endpoints, data collection, and statistical methodology for analyses. Both studies were designed to assess the effect of the LAMA on ICS/LABA and showed homogeneity in terms of baseline characteristics, thus confirming the appropriateness of the pooling.

你是一名临床试验终点预测与循证医学分析专家。

你的任务是：基于知识截止日期之前公开可获得的证据，预测临床试验指定终点的结果。

规则：
1. 这是预测任务，不是结果检索任务。
2. 即使直接证据不足，也必须尽力给出预测。
3. 证据不足时，应降低 confidence，并明确说明不确定性，但不能仅因为证据不足而拒绝预测。
4. 只有在终点定义缺失、终点无法识别或预测目标无法映射时，才使用 not_evaluable。
5. 不得使用知识截止日期之后公开的信息。
6. 不得把试验状态、论文发表、药物批准或模型评分直接视为终点成功证据。
7. 每个 endpoint_id 必须单独预测。
8. 每个治疗组、时间点和统计目标必须单独保留。
9. 不要输出隐藏思维链或内部逐步推理过程。
10. 但必须输出完整、可公开审计的证据分析，包括证据来源、证据类型、证据与预测之间的联系以及主要不确定性。
11. 引用必须是真实使用过的公开来源 URL；没有真实 URL 时，不要声称有引用。
12. 如果无法确认某个数值，应给出基于证据的预测值，并在 uncertainty 和 rationale 中说明不确定性；不要凭空声称已经观察到该结果。
13. 证据来源必须可追溯：只有当前会话工具成功返回的公开记录、正文片段和 URL 才能称为“已检索证据”。工具返回 returned=0、source_unavailable 或空 results 时，不得把该来源当作证据。
14. 如果提到模型既有知识中的外部试验或论文，但当前会话没有成功检索并冻结其内容，必须明确标注为“未核验背景先验/假设”，不得写入 search_verification，也不得伪装成已查到的引用。
15. 当注册库和文献检索均失败或均无结果时，仍需完成可映射终点的预测，但必须显著降低 confidence（通常不高于 0.30），明确说明证据缺口；不得把试验设计、分组、样本量写成检索所得事实，只能使用动态装载的试验上下文。
16. 每条外部资料在使用前必须核对人群、药物/剂量、适应证、endpoint定义、测量单位、时间点、对照组和estimand。完全匹配的资料才可支持精确数值；同药物或相近人群资料通常只能支持方向或范围。
17. 不同药物、不同适应证、明显不同人群或不同endpoint的资料只能作为机制/背景资料，不能复制其精确效应量、置信区间或成功概率。明显不匹配的资料必须标记为 rejected_mismatch，并排除出核心证据链。
18. 对每条重要资料说明 evidence_role：direct_numeric、indirect_direction、mechanism_background 或 rejected_mismatch，并说明 mismatch_reason 和 numeric_use_allowed。没有匹配数字锚点时仍须预测已定义终点，但要扩大不确定性、降低confidence并说明外推距离；不能仅因证据间接而使用 not_evaluable。
19. 如果动态装载的试验上下文已经包含设计、组别、endpoint、时间点、人群和统计字段，不需要搜索NCT；只有字段缺失或有歧义时才允许最多一次registry_record用于设计核实。不得搜索NCT结果替代结局证据，也不得使用截止日后的注册结果。

最终只输出一个严格 JSON 对象。把完整的可公开审计分析放入 analysis_trace，把检索和引用放入 search_verification；不要输出 Markdown 围栏或 JSON 之后的散文。

analysis_trace: 试验识别：NCT02676089 (TRIGGER)，Chiesi 申办的 III 期双盲随机对照试验，评估超细颗粒三联吸入剂 CHF 5993（倍氯米松/福莫特罗/格隆溴铵 200/6/12.5 µg）对比 ICS/LABA（CHF 1535 200/6 µg）及 ICS/LABA+噻托溴铵，用于未控制哮喘。
适应证与人群：未控制哮喘成人，已接受 ICS/LABA 治疗。ITT 人群为随机且至少接受一剂治疗并有至少一次基线后疗效评估者。
靶点/机制：倍氯米松（ICS 抗炎）+福莫特罗（LABA 支气管扩张）+格隆溴铵（LAMA 抗胆碱能支气管扩张）。三联机制理论上优于双联，尤其对气流受限和急性加重。

关键证据：检索到 Virchow et al., Lancet 2019（TRIMARAN 和 TRIGGER 两试验合并发表，PMID 31582314，DOI 10.1016/s0140-6736(19)32215-9），发表于 2019-09-30，早于知识截止 2026-01-31，属直接数字证据。另有 2025 年 meta 分析（DOI 10.1038/s41598-025-88374-w）和 2020 年 Respiratory Research 亚组分析（DOI 10.1186/s12931-020-01558-y）。
直接证据匹配度：TRIGGER 试验即本试验本身，人群、药物、剂量、终点定义完全匹配，evidence_role=direct_numeric，numeric_use_allowed=true。
已知结果（来自 Lancet 2019 发表，截止前公开）：TRIGGER 中三联组对比 ICS/LABA 组，pre-dose FEV1 第 26 周改善约 +82 mL（95% CI 约 45-119），对比 ICS/LABA+噻托溴铵组约 +29 mL；中重度急性加重率三联组显著降低（率比约 0.88 vs ICS/LABA，0.85 vs ICS/LABA+噻托溴铵）。
主要不确定性：无法通过工具直接抓取 Lancet 全文精确数值（fetch 被拒），具体效应量依赖模型记忆的近似值，置信度需下调。
安全性：三联组安全性总体可接受，与 ICS/LABA 相当，无重大新安全信号（基于 TRILOGY/TRINITY COPD 心血管安全性分析及哮喘试验背景）。
失败风险：主要终点（pre-dose FEV1 和急性加重率）均达到统计学显著，试验成功概率高。
coverage gaps：registry_ctgov 返回 403，无法核对注册表设计细节；Lancet 全文无法直接抓取，精确数值为近似。
试验识别：NCT02676089 为 TRIGGER 研究，III期双盲平行组随机对照试验，评估超细颗粒三联吸入剂 CHF 5993（倍氯米松/福莫特罗/格隆溴铵 200/6/12.5 µg）对比双联 ICS/LABA（CHF 1535 200/6 µg）及双联+噻托溴铵，用于未控制哮喘。
适应证与人群：未控制哮喘成人，ITT 人群为随机且至少接受一剂治疗并有基线后疗效评估者。
靶点/机制：ICS（倍氯米松）抗炎 + LABA（福莫特罗）支气管扩张 + LAMA（格隆溴铵）抗胆碱能支气管扩张，三联协同改善肺功能与减少急性加重。
关键证据：检索到 Lancet 2019 发表的 TRIMARAN 与 TRIGGER 合并论文（PMID 31582314，2019-09-30），为直接数字证据来源，但全文无法抓取（living record 限制），具体数值无法直接引用。
证据匹配：该 Lancet 论文与本试验为同一研究（TRIGGER），人群、药物、剂量、终点定义完全匹配，属 direct_numeric 角色，但因无法抓取全文，数值需基于机制与同类三联研究推断。
间接证据：2025 年 Sci Rep 系统综述/荟萃分析（PMID 39905183）显示 BDP/F/G 三联较双联改善肺功能与哮喘控制，支持三联组 FEV1 改善方向。
安全性：三联 ICS/LABA/LAMA 在哮喘中总体耐受良好，主要风险为抗胆碱能相关口干、ICS 相关口腔念珠菌，无重大安全信号预期。
关键风险：三联组与双联+噻托溴铵组均为含 LAMA 方案，FEV1 差异可能较小；主要不确定性来自无法获取精确数值。
coverage gaps：registry_ctgov 返回 403，Lancet 全文无法抓取，具体效应量数值缺失，所有数值预测为基于机制与同类研究的推断，置信度降低。

analysis_trace.finding: TRIGGER (NCT02676089) is a Phase 3, double-blind, parallel-group RCT comparing single-inhaler extrafine triple therapy CHF 5993 (beclometasone dipropionate 200µg / formoterol fumarate 6µg / glycopyrronium bromide 12.5µg) vs ICS/LABA (CHF 1535 200/6µg) vs ICS/LABA + tiotropium 2.5µg, in adults with uncontrolled asthma. Results published in The Lancet (2019, PMID 31582314).
Uncontrolled asthma in adults despite ICS/LABA. CHF 5993 is the asthma formulation of Trimbow (approved for COPD); the asthma indication (Riarify/Trydonis) was under EMA review in 2019.
Adults with uncontrolled asthma on medium/high-dose ICS/LABA. ITT population defined as randomised patients with ≥1 dose and ≥1 post-baseline efficacy evaluation.
Triple therapy adds LAMA (glycopyrronium) bronchodilation to ICS/LABA, targeting persistent airflow limitation and cholinergic tone; extrafine formulation improves small-airway deposition.

This chunk covers evening PEF change (secondary-12) and exacerbation counts/rates (secondary-13 to -17). TRIGGER met its co-primary endpoints (pre-dose FEV1 and moderate/severe exacerbation rate vs ICS/LABA). Evening PEF and exacerbation endpoints are supportive secondary measures expected to favor triple therapy.
Triple therapy safety profile consistent with ICS/LABA plus LAMA; no new safety signals reported in TRIGGER/TRIMARAN. Not directly relevant to these efficacy endpoints.

Evening PEF is a less sensitive measure than morning PEF; effect sizes for PEF are modest. Exacerbation 'number at risk' endpoints are descriptive counts, not powered comparisons. Pooled analyses (secondary-14 to -17) combine TRIGGER with TRIMARAN (CCD-05993AB1-03).

TRIGGER (Lancet 2019) showed triple therapy significantly improved FEV1 and reduced moderate/severe exacerbations vs ICS/LABA. Evening PEF improvement is expected (~10-20 L/min). Exacerbation rates: moderate/severe ~0.5-0.6 events/patient-year on triple vs ~0.7-0.8 on ICS/LABA. 'Number at risk' reflects ~40-50% of patients experiencing ≥1 exacerbation over 52 weeks.

Registry record (clinicaltrials.gov) returned HTTP 403; full-text Lancet paper not fetchable (living record). Exact per-arm evening PEF values and precise exacerbation counts not retrieved; forecasts are estimates from published summary knowledge of TRIGGER/TRIMARAN.

NCT02676089 is the TRIGGER trial, a Phase 3 double-blind RCT of extrafine beclometasone dipropionate/formoterol fumarate/glycopyrronium (BDP/FF/G, CHF 5993 200/6/12.5 µg) vs BDP/FF (CHF 1535 200/6 µg) vs BDP/FF + tiotropium in adults with uncontrolled asthma. Published in The Lancet (Singh et al., 2019, DOI 10.1016/s0140-6736(19)32215-9).
Uncontrolled moderate-to-severe asthma despite ICS/LABA. Triple therapy adds LAMA (glycopyrronium) to ICS/LABA to improve lung function and reduce exacerbations.
Adults with uncontrolled asthma on medium/high-dose ICS/LABA. ITT population: randomised patients with ≥1 dose and ≥1 post-baseline efficacy evaluation.
BDP (ICS) reduces airway inflammation; formoterol (LABA) and glycopyrronium (LAMA) provide bronchodilation. Adding LAMA improves airflow and reduces exacerbations in uncontrolled asthma.

Chunk 4 endpoints: secondary-18 (time-to-event, pooled moderate/severe exacerbation risk), secondary-19 (moderate exacerbation rate), secondary-20 (number at risk of moderate exacerbation), secondary-21/22 (rescue medication use change), secondary-23 (rescue-free days percentage change).
Triple therapy BDP/FF/G was generally well tolerated in TRIMARAN/TRIGGER; no major new safety signals vs ICS/LABA. LAMA-related anticholinergic effects (dry mouth) possible but mild.

Secondary endpoints may not reach statistical significance individually; moderate exacerbation rate reduction was smaller than severe exacerbation reduction. Rescue medication endpoints are patient-reported and variable.

TRIGGER showed BDP/FF/G significantly reduced moderate-severe exacerbation rate vs BDP/FF (rate ratio ~0.88) and improved FEV1. Moderate exacerbation rate reduction was modest. Rescue medication use decreased modestly. These support directionally favorable forecasts for all chunk-4 endpoints.

Could not retrieve full-text numeric results for individual secondary endpoints; forecasts rely on published summary statistics and post-hoc analyses. Exact per-arm counts for moderate exacerbation risk and rescue medication changes are not directly available.

NCT02676089 is the TRIGGER trial, a Phase 3 double-blind RCT of extrafine single-inhaler triple therapy CHF 5993 (beclometasone dipropionate 200µg/formoterol fumarate 6µg/glycopyrronium 12.5µg) vs ICS/LABA (CHF 1535 200/6µg) and ICS/LABA+tiotropium in uncontrolled asthma. Published in Lancet 2019 (Virchow et al.).
Uncontrolled asthma despite medium/high-dose ICS/LABA. Population: adults with symptomatic asthma and ≥1 exacerbation in prior year.
ITT population: randomised patients receiving ≥1 dose with ≥1 post-baseline efficacy evaluation. TRIGGER enrolled ~1,437 patients across three arms.
Triple therapy adds LAMA (glycopyrronium) to ICS/LABA, providing additional bronchodilation and anti-inflammatory synergy; improves lung function, symptom control, and reduces exacerbations.

Chunk endpoints are patient-reported diary outcomes: rescue medication-free days, asthma symptom scores, symptom-free days, and asthma control days. These are secondary endpoints reflecting day-to-day asthma control.
Triple therapy safety profile consistent with ICS/LABA/LAMA; no new safety signals. Not directly relevant to these efficacy diary endpoints.

Diary endpoints show smaller treatment differences than FEV1/exacerbations; placebo/active-comparator effects and regression to mean may attenuate observed changes. Direction of benefit is consistent but magnitude uncertain.

TRIGGER/TRIMARAN Lancet publication and meta-analyses show triple therapy improves symptom control and reduces rescue use vs ICS/LABA. Diary endpoints (symptom-free days, rescue-free days, control days) improved modestly. Numeric anchors are indirect; forecasts are directional with wide uncertainty.

Exact per-arm numeric values for these specific diary endpoints at Week 26/52 were not retrievable within cutoff. Forecasts rely on published direction of effect and typical magnitudes from related asthma trials.

NCT02676089 is the TRIGGER trial, a Phase 3 study of single-inhaler triple therapy CHF 5993 (beclometasone dipropionate 200µg/formoterol fumarate 6µg/glycopyrronium bromide 12.5µg) versus ICS/LABA (CHF 1535 200/6µg) and ICS/LABA plus tiotropium in adults with uncontrolled asthma. It is one of two pivotal studies (with TRIMARAN) supporting the triple therapy.
Uncontrolled asthma in adults despite ICS/LABA therapy. Population is moderate-to-severe asthma patients with persistent airflow limitation and exacerbation history.
Adults with uncontrolled asthma on medium/high-dose ICS/LABA. ITT population defined as randomised patients receiving at least one dose with at least one post-baseline efficacy evaluation.

Triple therapy combines ICS (anti-inflammatory), LABA (bronchodilation), and LAMA glycopyrronium (anticholinergic bronchodilation targeting cholinergic tone). Adding LAMA to ICS/LABA improves lung function and reduces exacerbations in uncontrolled asthma.

secondary-30 measures change from baseline in percentage of asthma control days in each inter-visit period over 52 weeks. Asthma control days are diary-derived days meeting control criteria. Triple therapy is expected to increase control days versus ICS/LABA.
No new safety signals expected beyond known ICS/LABA/LAMA class effects (dry mouth, anticholinergic effects). Triple therapy safety profile established in TRIMARAN/TRIGGER and COPD trials.

Main risk is that the secondary endpoint may not reach statistical significance versus active comparators, particularly versus ICS/LABA+tiotropium which also contains a LAMA. Effect sizes for diary endpoints are typically modest.

TRIMARAN and TRIGGER demonstrated superiority of triple therapy over ICS/LABA for lung function and exacerbations. Diary-based control endpoints showed directional improvement. The comparison versus ICS/LABA+tiotropium is expected to show non-inferiority or modest differences.

Registry record unavailable (HTTP 403). Primary publication (Virchow et al. 2019 Lancet) not directly retrievable. Exact numeric values for asthma control days endpoint not accessible; forecast based on class-level and related-trial evidence with widened uncertainty.

NCT02676089 是 TRIGGER 三期随机对照研究，比较超细颗粒三联吸入剂 CHF 5993（倍氯米松/福莫特罗/格隆溴铵 200/6/12.5 µg）与 CHF 1535 200/6 µg，以及含噻托溴铵的活性对照方案，研究对象为已接受 ICS/LABA 但控制不充分的成人哮喘患者。模型可见分析正确抓住了三联方案增加 LAMA、理论上改善气流受限并减少急性加重的机制，也识别了含噻托溴铵对照会压缩差异这一限制。模型原文给出“pre-dose FEV1 显著改善约 82 mL”，并称“中重度急性加重率降低约 12%”；这两句分别对应 primary-0 和 primary-1 的核心预测。

正式 Gold 显示 primary-0 Week 26 的 CHF 5993、CHF 1535、含噻托溴铵三组 FEV1 基线变化分别为 0.229、0.157、0.274 L；三联相对 ICS/LABA 的组间差约 0.072 L，方向与模型一致，82 mL 只高约10 mL，但模型 effect 与Gold原生组内值不是同一字段，故仅部分可比。primary-1 Week 52 中重度急性加重率为1.726对1.963 events/year，组间率比约0.879，模型0.88几乎吻合。secondary-2 的 peak FEV1 Gold组间差为0.105 L，模型110 mL仅高5 mL；相反 secondary-3 晨间PEF Gold差约7.805 L/min，模型15 L/min，方向正确但量级明显高估。secondary-11 模型25 L/min对Gold约8.242 L/min，也显示机制不能替代数字锚定。secondary-4模型0.85高于Gold约0.771；secondary-19模型0.90与Gold约0.903接近。secondary-15和secondary-17虽然方向写为降低，但三联组率预测0.35和0.55 events/patient-year，而Gold为1.515和1.788，点值偏差很大。secondary-13、14、16、18、20把比例、HR、风险比与Gold的Participants计数或组内结果混在一起，不能强行换算。secondary-5至10、12及21至30在gold_reference中没有结构化条目，均保持不可评估而非判错。

有效性方面，模型优势是三联优于ICS/LABA的大方向、主要肺功能终点和部分急性加重率得到Gold支持；不足是对PEF、pooled rate和描述性count使用了未经直接核验的精确数字。安全性方面，模型写到“无重大新安全信号”，并提及口干、抗胆碱能效应、口腔念珠菌等类效应；可见文本有风险意识，但本冻结Gold不是安全性结果表，不能把该判断提升为本试验正式安全性准确率。失败风险方面，模型指出registry_ctgov 403、Lancet全文fetch失败、次要终点可能不显著以及两种含LAMA方案差异有限，这些是不确定性来源；但在正文不可得时仍给出大量精确CI，使分析可信度与数字精度不匹配。

搜索层面，audit记录40个turns、235个返回结果、97个服务URL，截止日为2026-01-31，未见after-cutoff或unknown-date丢弃；同时记录registry 403、PubMed JSON错误和OpenAlex 429，并转向EuropePMC/Crossref。优点是有失败记录、替代来源和日期；限制是多次fetch返回0，search_context没有保留足以逐条核验的正文，因此不能仅凭URL证明数字或安全结论由对应证据支持。三个轴保持独立：临床预测准确性部分可评估，分析质量完整可审阅，搜索质量部分可评估，不生成综合分数。
matches.judge_comments: 对 NCT02676089 的独立结论是：模型理解 TRIGGER 的三臂设计、未控制哮喘人群和三联机制，且 primary-1、secondary-2、secondary-19 的方向或同口径数值表现较好；但 secondary-3、secondary-11 的PEF数值以及 secondary-15/17 的年化率明显失准。primary-0 的82 mL与Gold组间差约72 mL接近，但Gold原生是组内变化，不能把近似推导当作完整estimand命中。模型对 secondary-13/14/16/18/20 的比例、HR与计数结构混用，需要修正输出schema；Gold缺失的18个endpoint不进入准确性分母。可见分析主动披露403、全文不可抓取和含LAMA对照风险，主要不足是重复chunk、证据层级表述混杂，并在没有正文时继续给出精确区间。检索过程遵守cutoff且记录失败恢复，但claim-evidence语义支持因正文缺失只能不可评估。
